postal_system.scope: Current PTT province/district/neighbourhood/street lookup and July 2022 UPU address format; bounded real assignment sample, no postal-area geometry.

stages.definition: Reviewed current PTT lookup, format, rights, quality and UI authority contract with exact reference hashes.

A current complete-for-declared-coverage, rights-cleared Türkiye five-digit postcode assignment and exact Polygon/MultiPolygon delivery-area release preserves street, neighbourhood, P.O. box, poste-restante and locality exceptions using explicit permitted relations. Exact retrieval time, edition, validity, CRS, schema, topology, feature identity and SHA-256 reproducibly produce approved immutable artifacts. The real TR loader and API normalize five-digit input and return valid area geometry. The application searches country plus postcode, distinguishes loading/not-found/multiple/API-failure/invalid/non-area states, fits the map, renders a translucent fill and clear boundary, permits clear and repeat search, and displays normalized postcode, geometry type, official/derived/virtual authority, source, basis date and confidence. Points, postal offices, routes, P.O. boxes, organizations, learned cells and administrative boundaries are never promoted to postal polygons; house numbers and buildings require separate explicit address relations. Synthetic fixtures or shared UI code alone never establish M2.

agid_integration.current_scope: TR five-digit syntax and a bounded current PTT address-assignment sample are reviewed; no real Postal Context area pack, runtime or searchable map area.
agid_integration.enablement_gate: Rights-cleared complete assignments and exact area artifact plus real loader/API/app verification are required.
agid_integration.geometry_rule: Only source-qualified Polygon/MultiPolygon postal features can drive the translucent search overlay; assignment rows and every other non-area geometry stay typed and cannot be promoted.
